findings.fix: Factor out a lemma. If every class in the support of each `K j l` satisfies `μ₀(r₀ l) - degree(q A) = μ(r j) + ε`, then `novikovMapOfMatrix` of `coefficientComparison q hq ∘ K` maps cochain degree `f` to `f + ε`. Use it in both coboundary theorems.
findings.issue: The step 'K lowers cochain degree by one' is an 8-line `simpa ... using novikovMapOfMatrix_mem_gradeBy ...` block, copied almost exactly into `..._mem_coboundaries_right` and `..._mem_coboundaries_left`. summary: Proofs are short and avoid defeq tricks, but two blocks of reasoning are duplicated verbatim across the right/left theorems, and one of them re-derives the existing simp lemma `novikovMapOfMatrix_one` by hand.
